blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: \textit{Objective:} Ultrasound videos are limited by hardware-constrained spatial resolution and signal-dependent speckle, while paired low- and high-resolution acquisitions for supervised restoration are rarely available. We aim to jointly super-resolve and despeckle ultrasound videos without paired training data or network retraining. \textit{Methods:} We propose UltraDiff, which uses a frozen pre-trained diffusion model (DM) as a plug-in prior and restores each frame by optimizing the latent seed of the DM sampler under a range-constrained maximum a posteriori formulation. We derive a speckle-aware data-fidelity term from a Rayleigh scale-family model and characterize its relative-residual and variance-adaptive weighting properties. We further introduce a stabilized fidelity that is bounded below and strictly convex in log intensity for positive observations in its unclamped form. A total-variation regularizer complements the DM prior, and a temporal seed update warm-starts each frame from the optimized seed of its predecessor. \textit{Results:} On EchoNet-LVH videos with simulated speckle and additive noise, UltraDiff with a natural-image prior improves PSNR by 1.24\,dB over the strongest baseline, and ultrasound-related priors improve it further. On real clinical echocardiography videos, UltraDiff reduces the mean absolute error of zero-shot ejection fraction (EF) prediction from 7.31 to 6.37 EF points relative to DUP, the strongest baseline. \textit{Conclusion:} Combining a speckle-aware fidelity with frozen diffusion priors enables ground-truth-free ultrasound video restoration that benefits downstream measurement. \textit{Significance:} UltraDiff needs neither paired data nor retraining and is not tied to a specific diffusion checkpoint. Code associated with this work will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Ultrasound (US) imaging is widely used in cardiology [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] , obstetrics [ 4 , 5 ] , and musculoskeletal imaging [ 6 ] because it is real-time, non-invasive, and cost-effective. Compared with static US images, US videos capture dynamic tissue motion, which is essential for applications such as breast lesion assessment [ 7 , 8 ] and cardiovascular monitoring [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] . In echocardiography, ejection fraction (EF) estimation depends on clear cardiac structures throughout the cardiac cycle.
blocks.zh: 超声波成像被广泛用于心电学[1,2,3],产科[4,5],和肌肉骨骼成像[6],因为它是实时的,非侵入性的,成本效益高. 与静态的美国图像相比,美国视频捕捉动态组织运动,这对于乳腺癌评估[7,8]和心血管监测[9,10,11]等应用至关重要. 在回声心电图中,弹出分数(EF)的估算取决于整个心脏周期的清晰心肌结构.

blocks.en: Despite these advantages, the quality of US videos is inherently constrained by the physics of acoustic imaging. Spatial resolution is limited by the frequency-penetration trade-off of transducer design, while image quality is further affected by signal-dependent speckle noise caused by the interference of backscattered waves [ 12 ] . Classical despeckling methods reduce these fluctuations [ 13 , 12 ] , but must balance noise suppression against the loss of tissue echotexture, which itself carries diagnostic information. These degradations reduce boundary visibility and can compromise downstream measurements such as automated EF prediction. Super-resolution (SR) offers a computational route beyond hardware-limited resolution [ 14 ] . However, robust US video restoration remains challenging: paired low-resolution (LR) and high-resolution (HR) US videos are rarely available, acquisition conditions vary across devices and operators, and US noise statistics differ substantially from natural-image degradations. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , representative SR baselines either over-smooth cardiac structures or fail to recover realistic tissue texture.

blocks.en: 1.1 Related Work and Motivation
blocks.zh: 1.1 相关工作和动机

blocks.en: SR methods for natural images and videos have advanced rapidly with large-scale paired datasets [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] . Single-image SR methods commonly use deep convolutional networks [ 18 , 19 ] , while video SR methods incorporate temporal information through flow-based [ 20 ] or attention-based mechanisms [ 21 ] . However, these models are typically trained on fixed degradation distributions and may generalize poorly to clinical US videos, where image appearance, resolution, and speckle patterns vary across acquisition settings.
blocks.zh: 自然图像和视频的SR方法随着大规模对接数据集[15,16,17]迅速进步. 单相的SR方法通常使用深演化网络[18,19],而视频的SR方法则通过基于流 [20] 或基于注意力的机制[21]来包含时间信息. 然而,这些模型通常在固定降解分布方面得到培训,可能无法普遍到临床的美国视频,因为图像的外观、分辨率和光谱模式因获取环境而异。

blocks.en: In US image SR, paired LR and HR data of the same anatomy are particularly difficult to obtain, so existing studies rely on simulated pairs or self-supervised strategies. Choi et al. [ 22 ] adapted SRGAN [ 23 ] for B-mode US image enhancement, while a U-Net-style architecture [ 24 ] was trained on simulated pairs for super-resolved US reconstruction. Liu et al. [ 25 ] proposed ZSSR-Cycle, a zero-shot and self-supervised generative adversarial framework for US image SR. A related line of work exploits the implicit prior of network architectures: Deep Image Prior (DIP) [ 26 ] fits a randomly initialized network to a single degraded image, and its video extensions propagate network weights or priors across frames [ 27 , 28 ] . Following this paradigm, DUP [ 29 ] performs video-adaptive, ground-truth-free US video quality improvement. These methods re-fit network parameters for every input and rely on early stopping to avoid fitting noise. Moreover, they do not explicitly couple a learned generative prior with a speckle-aware US measurement model.
blocks.zh: 在美国映像SR中,同一解剖学的配对LR和HR数据特别难以获得,因此现有的研究依赖于模拟对等或自我监督的策略. 崔等编. [22]为B-mode US图像增强而改编了SRGAN [23],而一款U-Net风格的建筑[24]则接受了模拟配对的训练,用于超级解析的美国重建. 刘等. [25] 提出ZSSR-Cycle,为美国形象SR的零发和自控基因对抗框架. 一个相关的工作项目利用了网络架构的内含: 深图像 Prior (DIP) [26] 将随机初始化的网络与单一已退化的图像相匹配,其视频扩展可传播网络权重或前缀跨帧[27,28]. 根据这个模式,DUP[29] 进行了视频适应性、无地真相的美国视频质量改进。 这些方法为每个输入重新调整了网络参数并依靠早期停止来避免合适的噪音. 此外,它们并未明确将一个有学识的遗传学与一个有分光意识的美国测量模型相配。

blocks.en: Diffusion models (DMs) have been widely used as generative priors for image restoration, improving perceptual detail through iterative denoising [ 30 , 31 ] . Diffusion-based methods have been explored for video enhancement [ 32 ] and US image SR [ 33 ] . DMPlug [ 34 ] shows that a pre-trained DM can be used as a plug-in prior for inverse problems without task-specific retraining, by optimizing the input of the sampler under a least-squares fidelity on single images. Applying such priors to US video restoration, however, is non-trivial: (i) a least-squares fidelity implicitly assumes signal-independent noise, which is inconsistent with multiplicative speckle; (ii) the method must adapt to each LR video without paired HR supervision; and (iii) temporal redundancy should be exploited without training additional temporal modules.
blocks.zh: 扩散模型(DM)被广泛用作图像还原的基因前传,通过迭代去诺化来改进知觉细节[30,31]. 探索了基于传播的方法来增强视频[32]和美国图像SR[33]. DMPlug [34] 显示在不针对特定任务进行再培训的情况下,通过在单一图像上最小的平方忠诚度下优化采样器输入,在反向问题之前,可以使用预先训练过的DM作为插件. 然而,将这种前科应用于美国视频修复是非三角性的:(一) 最低方位的忠诚含蓄地假定信号独立的噪音,这与多发性光谱不一致;(二) 该方法必须适应每个LR视频,而不配对人力资源监督;(三) 应利用时间冗余,而不培训额外的时间模块。

blocks.en: 1.2 Contributions
blocks.zh: 1.2 缴款

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose UltraDiff, a self-supervised framework for ultrasound video super-resolution and despeckling. UltraDiff uses a frozen pre-trained diffusion model as a plug-in prior and adapts it to each LR video by optimizing latent seeds rather than model parameters. The optimized HR frames are constrained by a degradation operator and a speckle-aware data-fidelity term, so restoration is guided by both the learned image prior and the ultrasound measurement model. The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出UltraDiff,一个超声波视频超级解析和分辨的自控框架. UltraDiff使用被冷冻的预先训练的传播模型作为前置插件,并通过优化潜在种子而不是模型参数来适应每个LR视频. 优化后的HR帧受到降解操作器和Speckle-aware数据真实性术语的制约,因此恢复既受所学图像前和超声波测量模型的指导. 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We propose UltraDiff , a self-supervised US video restoration framework for joint super-resolution and despeckling that requires neither paired HR videos nor DM retraining. • We develop a speckle-aware restoration objective based on a Rayleigh scale-family model and a range-constrained MAP-inspired formulation. We characterize its relative-residual behavior and local variance-adaptive weighting, and introduce a stabilized fidelity with favorable optimization properties. • We introduce a temporal seed update (SUP) strategy that warm-starts each frame from the optimized seed of its predecessor, combining the previous optimized seed with Gaussian perturbations and reducing the iteration budget for subsequent frames. • We validate UltraDiff on two public echocardiography datasets , showing improved restoration quality, noise robustness, and zero-shot EF prediction over representative SR baselines, with ablations verifying key components.

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: For restoration evaluation, we use the EchoNet-LVH dataset [ 9 ] , which contains high-resolution echocardiography videos with a resolution of 1024 × \times 768 pixels and 90–200 frames per clip. Each video is cropped and resized to 256 × \times 256, and the resulting frames are treated as reference HR videos. Since physically paired LR–HR ultrasound videos are rarely available, we follow the common full-reference evaluation protocol in ultrasound SR studies [ 22 , 24 , 25 , 29 ] : LR observations are generated using 2 × \times bicubic downsampling, followed by multiplicative Rayleigh speckle and additive Gaussian noise with a shared standard deviation varied from 0.02 to 0.10 to control the overall degradation strength. The same degraded LR inputs and HR references are used for all competing methods, ensuring a fair comparison under identical input conditions. Restoration quality is measured with the full-reference metrics PSNR, SSIM [ 37 ] , and LPIPS [ 38 ] , and the no-reference metrics NIQE [ 39 ] , PIQE [ 40 ] , and TOPIQ-NR [ 41 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了恢复评价,我们使用EchoNet-LVH数据集[9],其中包含高分辨率回声心电图视频,分辨率为1024x\times 768像素和每段90-200帧. 每段视频被收割并被调整为256×\times 256,所制作的帧被作为参考HR视频处理. 由于物理配对的LR-HR超声波视频很少获得,因此我们在超声波SR研究中遵循共同的全参考评价协议[22,24,25,29]: LR观测是使用2×\times双立体下取样生成的,然后是多发性Rayleigh specle和具有共享标准偏差的添加剂高斯噪音从0.02到0.10来控制整体降解强度. 所有相互竞争的方法都使用同样的退化的LR输入和人力资源参考,确保在同一输入条件下进行公平比较。 恢复质量的测量标准包括:PSNR、SSIM[37]和LPIPS[38],以及无参考指标NIQE[39]、PIQE[40]和TOPIQ-NR[41]。

blocks.en: For downstream evaluation, we use the EchoNet-Dynamic dataset [ 36 ] , which contains real clinical echocardiography videos of 112 × \times 112 pixels and 28–1002 frames per clip, together with reference EF labels. We select 100 videos using EF-stratified sampling so that the subset follows the EF distribution of the full dataset. This evaluation does not rely on synthetic degradations or HR references. Instead, it tests whether restoration improves functional measurement on real clinical videos, where the true degradation is unknown.
blocks.zh: 对于下游的评价,我们使用EchoNet-Dynamic数据集[36],其中包含真实的临床回声心电图视频,每段112×分112像素和28-1002帧,以及参考EF标签. 我们使用EF级分样选择了100个视频,这样子集就跟随了EF全数据集的分布. 本评价不依赖合成降解或人力资源参考。 相反,它检验恢复是否改进了真实临床视频的功能测量,其中真实降解情况不明.

blocks.en: 3.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 3.2 执行细节

blocks.en: Our main UltraDiff configuration uses a CelebA-HQ pre-trained diffusion model as the frozen generative prior. This default is deliberate: the prior has never seen US data, so improvements can be attributed to the proposed formulation rather than to domain-specific training or any overlap between the training data, allowing us to test whether the proposed test-time optimization can adapt a generic image SR prior to ultrasound restoration. Unless otherwise noted, UltraDiff refers to this CelebA-HQ-prior configuration, which is used for ablation studies and downstream EF prediction.
blocks.zh: 我们的主UltraDiff配置使用CelebA-HQ预训扩散模型作为被冷冻的先基因. 这种默认是故意的:先前从未见过美国的数据,因此改进可以归因于提议的配制,而不是针对特定域的训练或训练数据之间的任何重叠,让我们可以测试提议的测试时间优化是否能够在超声波修复之前调整出通用图像SR. 除非另有说明,UltraDiff指的是这种CelebA-HQ先行配置,用于去除研究和下游EF预测.

blocks.en: To examine the sensitivity to the choice of frozen diffusion prior, we also instantiate the same UltraDiff optimization framework with two additional priors, denoted UltraDiff-DFUI and UltraDiff-ZEA, in the restoration comparison.
blocks.zh: 为了检查在前作中选择被冷冻扩散的敏感性,我们还用另外两个前作,表示UltraDiff-DFUI和UltraDiff-ZEA,在还原比较中,将相同的UltraDiff优化框架即时化.

blocks.en: During test-time optimization, a DDIM sampler [ 30 ] maps each latent seed to an HR estimate, while the diffusion model weights remain fixed and only the latent seed is optimized. The degradation operator 𝒜 \mathcal{A} is implemented with bicubic downsampling, and the regularization weight is set to λ = 0.001 \lambda=0.001 in Eq. 9 . For the seed update strategy, the perturbation noise level is fixed at 0.1.
blocks.zh: 在试验时间优化期间,一个DDIM采样器[30]将每个潜在种子映射到HR估计值上,而扩散模型重量保持不变,只有潜在种子才被优化. 降解操作员 A\ mathcal{A} 以双立分下取样方式执行, 规范重被设定为 Eq. 9 = 0.001\ lambda= 0.01。 对于种子更新策略,扰动噪声水平被固定为0.1.

blocks.en: For the first frame of each video, we run up to 3000 optimization steps and enable early stopping after 2000 steps with patience 100. For subsequent frames, we reduce the maximum number of optimization steps to 2000 and enable early stopping after 800 steps with the same patience, since these frames are initialized from the propagated seed. For downstream evaluation, we use EchoCLIP [ 10 ] in a zero-shot setting to predict EF from SR videos. All input frames are resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 before inference. All experiments are implemented in PyTorch and conducted on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 GPU with 24 GB memory. Baselines are evaluated on the same LR inputs using their public settings or official implementations.
blocks.zh: 每段视频的第一帧,我们运行了多达3000个优化步骤,并让2000年后的早期停止有100个耐心步骤. 对于后来的相框,我们把最优化步骤的最大数量减少到2000年,并且能够以同样的耐心在800个相框后及早停止,因为这些相框是从所传播的种子上初始化的. 对于下游的评价,我们使用EchoCLIP [10] 在零镜头设定中从SR视频中预测EF. 所有输入帧在推论前被调整为224×224 2.24\times 224. 所有实验都用PyTorch进行,在单NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 GPU上进行,并有24GB内存. 基线是根据其公共环境或正式实施情况对相同的常住人口投入进行评估的。

blocks.en: 3.3 Comparison with Baselines
blocks.zh: 3.3 与基线的比较

blocks.en: We compare UltraDiff with five representative baselines from four groups: Bicubic interpolation, learning-based single-image SR (EDSR [ 18 ] ), video-based SR/restoration (DiffVSR [ 32 ] and DUP [ 29 ] ), and ultrasound-specific SR (ZSSR-Cycle [ 25 ] ). This set covers interpolation, generic image SR, video restoration, and ultrasound-oriented SR. All methods use the same LR inputs and HR references, so differences reflect restoration behavior rather than degradation settings.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了超Diff和四个组的五个有代表性的基线: Bicubic内插,以学习为主的单图SR(EDSR [18]),以视频为主的SR/恢复(DiffVSR [32]和DUP [29]),和特超声波特异性SR(ZSSR-Cycle [25]). 本集涵盖内插,通用图像SR,视频修复,并面向超声波的SR. 所有方法都使用相同的LR输入和HR引用,因此差异反映的是还原行为而不是降解设置.

blocks.en: Fig. 3 shows a qualitative comparison on a 2 × \times SR example corrupted by mixed noise with std of 0.04. UltraDiff reconstructs clearer ventricular structures and produces lower errors in the zoomed regions than the baselines. For ultrasound restoration, improved sharpness should not come at the cost of distorted anatomical boundaries or unrealistic speckle texture.
blocks.zh: 图3显示一个2×x\times SSR被混合噪声腐蚀而成的std为0.04. UltraDiff重建更清晰的通风结构,并在被放大的区域产生比基线更低的误差. 对于超声波修复,提高锐度不应以扭曲解剖边界或不切实际的分光纹理为代价。

blocks.en: The quantitative results in Table 1 further support the visual comparison. The main UltraDiff-CelebA-HQ setting achieves 25.04 PSNR and 0.8209 SSIM, outperforming all non-UltraDiff baselines on both metrics. This result suggests that the proposed test-time diffusion-prior optimization can adapt a frozen image SR prior to echocardiography restoration, even when the prior is not trained specifically on ultrasound videos. The additional UltraDiff-DFUI and UltraDiff-ZEA variants use the same optimization framework with DFUI [ 42 ] and ZEA [ 43 ] frozen priors, respectively, with ZEA achieving the strongest restoration scores. This shows that UltraDiff is not tied to a single checkpoint, while CelebA-HQ remains the default setting for ablation and downstream analyses.
blocks.zh: 表1中的量化结果进一步支持了视觉对比. 主要的UltraDiff-CelebA-HQ设置实现了25.04 PSNR和0.8209 SSIM,在两个度量衡上都超过了所有非UltraDiff基线. 这一结果表明,拟议的测试时间扩散-前置优化可以在回声心电图恢复前调整被冻结的图像SR,即使前置没有专门接受超声波视频的培训. 附加的UltraDiff-DFUI和UltraDiff-ZEA的变体分别采用了与DFUI [42]和ZEA [43]被冻结的前身相同的优化框架,ZEA实现了最强的恢复分数. 这表明UltraDiff没有被绑在一个单一的检查站上,而CelebA-HQ仍然是进行通缩和下游分析的默认设置.

blocks.en: 3.4 Robustness and Runtime Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.4 稳健性和运行时间分析

blocks.en: To evaluate robustness under different degradation strengths, Fig. 4 reports PSNR and SSIM as the mixed-noise level increases from 0.02 to 0.10. UltraDiff maintains higher reconstruction quality and a more concentrated distribution, suggesting that the speckle-aware fidelity term and diffusion prior stabilize restoration under stronger degradation.
blocks.zh: 为了评估不同降解强度下的稳健性,图4报告了PSNR和SSIM,混合噪音水平从0.02提高到0.10。 UltraDiff保持了较高的重建质量和更集中的分布,表明光谱-感知忠心学术语和传播在更强烈的退化下预先稳定恢复.

blocks.en: UltraDiff is a test-time optimization method intended for offline restoration. Under the setup in Section 3.2 , it restores a frame in about 83 s on average, comparable to DUP (77 s) and faster than DiffVSR (93 s) and ZSSR-Cycle (152 s), but slower than feed-forward baselines such as Bicubic and EDSR. The cost is dominated by per-frame latent optimization, while SUP warm-start and early stopping help reduce the cost for subsequent frames. This trade-off is suitable for retrospective EF analysis, where offline processing is acceptable.
blocks.zh: UltraDiff是一种测试时间优化方法,用于离线修复. 在3.2节的设置下,它平均恢复了约83s的帧,可与DUP(77 s)相媲美并快于DiffVSR(93 s)和ZSSR-Cycle(152 s),但慢于比库比克和EDSR等向导基线. 成本以每帧潜在优化为主,而SUP温暖起动和早期停止则有助于降低后帧的成本. 这种取舍适合追溯式EF分析,其中离线处理是可以接受的.

blocks.en: 3.5 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 3.5 阅读研究

blocks.en: We conduct ablation studies to isolate the contribution of each component in UltraDiff. Specifically, we replace the proposed fidelity term with an MSE-based fidelity, remove TV regularization, and disable the seed update strategy. As shown in Table 2 , each modification degrades performance, confirming that the fidelity term, regularization, and temporal seed propagation all contribute to restoration quality.
blocks.zh: 我们进行减肥研究,以隔离UltraDiff中每个组件的贡献. 具体地说,我们用基于MSE的忠诚来取而代之,取消电视规范化,并禁用种子更新策略。 如表2所显示的,每次修改都会降低性能,证实忠诚期、正规化和时间种子传播都有助于恢复质量。

blocks.en: Replacing ℓ s \ell_{s} with the MSE reduces PSNR from 25.04 to 24.42 dB and increases LPIPS from 0.1101 to 0.1233, consistent with Propositions 1 and 2 : the homoscedastic MSE over-weights bright, high-variance regions, whereas ℓ s \ell_{s} measures residuals relative to the local signal level. Removing TV yields a comparable PSNR drop (24.47 dB) and a higher PIQE, reflecting its role in promoting piecewise-constant structures: it suppresses residual fluctuations within homogeneous regions, such as the blood pool and myocardium, while preserving tissue boundaries. Disabling SUP causes the largest degradation, especially in SSIM, LPIPS, and PIQE: without the warm start, each frame starts from an unrelated seed whose initial estimate is far from the target, so the optimization is less likely to reach a good solution within the budget, in line with the bounded-discrepancy argument in Section 2.4 .

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Role of the priors. The DM enters ( 8 ) not as an explicit density but through the range constraint I ∈ ℛ ⁡ ( ℳ ) I\in\mathcal{R}(\mathcal{M}) and the inductive bias of the pre-trained denoiser. TV is an explicit regularizer that favors piecewise-constant structures: it suppresses residual noise within homogeneous regions, such as the blood pool and myocardium, while preserving sharp tissue boundaries, and it stabilizes the ill-posed SR problem. The two priors are complementary: TV regularizes homogeneous regions, whereas fine tissue texture is supplied by the DM.
blocks.zh: 前辈的角色。 DM 输入 (8) 并不是一个明显的密度,而是通过范围限制 I \\ R \ (M) I\in\ mathcal{R}(\mathcal{M}) 和预训练的denoiser 的诱导偏差. TV是一种明显的常态化器,它有利于分件-恒定结构:它抑制了血池和心肌等同质区域内的残留噪声,同时保留了尖锐的组织界限,稳定了备受不便的SR问题. 这两个前科是相辅相成的:电视将同质区域正规化,而精细的组织纹理则由德国马克提供。

blocks.en: Choice of prior. Because K K is small and z z is optimized without constraint, ℛ ⁡ ( ℳ ) \mathcal{R}(\mathcal{M}) is in practice not restricted to the images on which the DM was trained (e.g., faces for CelebA-HQ). Although natural and medical images differ greatly at the whole-image scale, the statistics of local features, such as heavy-tailed gradient distributions, are similar across domains, and diffusion-based reconstruction outside the training distribution is driven primarily by such local features [ 44 ] . Accordingly, DMs trained on natural images, including CelebA-HQ, outperform medical-image-trained DMs in out-of-distribution MRI and CT reconstruction [ 44 ] and enable training-free enhancement across medical modalities, including ultrasound [ 45 ] . This reliance on local regularity also mitigates hallucination of domain-specific content: global structures of the training domain are not imposed, because the data term ties 𝒜 ​ ℳ ​ ( z ) \mathcal{A}\mathcal{M}(z) to the observation at every pixel while the prior mainly contributes local regularity. The natural-image default thus shows that the gains stem from the formulation rather than domain-specific training.
blocks.zh: 选择先前。 由于KK是小的,z z是不受约束地优化的,因此R ⁡ (M)\ mathcal{R} (\mathcal{M})在实际操作中并不局限于DM所训练的图像(例如CelebA-HQ的面相). 虽然自然图像和医学图像在全成像尺度上差异很大,但各地特征的统计,如重尾梯度分布,在各域之间类似,培训分布之外以传播为主的重建主要由这些本地特征所驱动 [44]. 因此,包括CelebA-HQ在内的关于自然图像的培训模式模式在分配外核磁共振和CT重建方面超过了医学图像培训模式模式[44],使包括超声波在内的各种医疗模式的无培训增强成为可能。 这种对本地正态性的依赖也缓解了域特定内容的幻觉:培训域的全局结构没有被强制,因为数据术语将A M (z)\mathcal{A}\mathcal{M}(z)与每个像素的观测联系起来,而前一个主要贡献局部正态. 因此,自然形象缺省表明,收益来自配制,而不是特定领域的培训。

blocks.en: Extensions of the measurement model. UltraDiff operates on displayed intensities, which makes it directly applicable to standard clinical archives such as EchoNet without access to raw data. The log-residual form of the fidelity (Proposition 1 (i)) is naturally compatible with the logarithmic display of US images, and the scale-family formulation accommodates other speckle statistics, e.g., for partially developed speckle [ 12 ] , simply by changing f f . The EF results on real videos, whose degradation is unknown, indicate robustness beyond the operator. Promising extensions include envelope or radio-frequency data where available, spatially correlated speckle models, and joint estimation of 𝒜 \mathcal{A} for fully blind restoration.

blocks.en: Future directions. The modular design of UltraDiff allows each component to be upgraded independently. On the prior side, video DMs with built-in temporal modeling and ultrasound foundation DMs can be plugged in without retraining. On the regularization side, higher-order terms [ 46 ] and total generalized variation [ 47 ] , which favor piecewise-smooth rather than piecewise-constant solutions, can further refine smoothly varying tissue regions. The per-frame optimization can be accelerated through diffusion distillation, consistency models, fewer sampling steps, or amortized seed prediction toward near-real-time operation. Building on the EF results reported here, future validation will cover higher scale factors, other anatomies such as obstetric and musculoskeletal US, dedicated temporal-consistency metrics, and clinical reader studies.
blocks.zh: 未来方向. UltraDiff的模块化设计允许每个组件独立升级. 在前一面,带有内置时间模型和超声波基础DM的视频DM可以插入而无需再培训. 在规范化方面,更高顺序的术语[46]和总的通变[47],它们倾向于片面-平滑而不是片面-恒定的解决方案,可以使不同的组织区域得到更平稳的完善. 通过扩散分馏,一致性模型,较少的采样步骤,或向近实时操作进行分期种子预测,可以加快每帧优化. 在EF结果的基础上,未来的验证将涵盖更大规模的因子,其他解剖如产科和肌肉骨骼美国,专用时间一致性测量,以及临床读者研究。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented UltraDiff, a self-supervised US video restoration framework that uses a frozen pre-trained diffusion model as a plug-in prior. By optimizing latent seeds under a range-constrained MAP-inspired formulation with a speckle-aware, variance-adaptive fidelity and a temporal seed update, UltraDiff performs joint super-resolution and despeckling without paired HR data or model retraining. Experiments on two public echocardiography datasets demonstrate improved restoration quality, robustness to mixed noise, and better zero-shot EF prediction than representative SR baselines, supporting diffusion-prior-based self-supervised restoration for retrospective US video analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了UltraDiff,一个自控的美国视频修复框架,它使用被冷冻的预先训练的传播模型作为前置插件. UltraDiff通过在射程受限的MAP启发配方下优化潜在种子,使其具有分光-意识、差异-可适应的忠诚度和时间种子更新,在不配对HR数据或模式再培训的情况下进行联合超分辨率和分光。 对两个公共回声心学数据集的实验表明,恢复质量得到提高,对混合噪声的强烈性,以及比有代表性的SR基线更好的零发EF预测,支持以扩散为主的自我监督修复以追溯美国视频分析.
